Includes data from Canada!!

# Set up environment

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
# Load in packages
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here)

# Set working directory
here::i_am("scripts/L3/300_curate_acknowledgements.qmd")

# Point to directories
L2_data_dir <- here("data", "L2") # L2 data
L3_data_dir <- here("data", "L3") # L3 data
```


# Read data

```{r}
#| label: read-inat-ept-data
# Read in EPT data from iNaturalist
EUSA_EPT_inat_df <- readRDS(here(
  L2_data_dir,
  "207a_EUSA_EPT_final_annotated.rds"
)) |>
  left_join(
    read_csv(here(L2_data_dir, "201a_clean_EUSA_EPT_obs.csv")),
    join_by("observation_id" == "id")
  )

# Join iNat metadata to study observations
EUSA_EPT_metadata_df <- EUSA_EPT_inat_df |>
  select(species, life_stage, observation_id, evidence_type) |>
  left_join(
    # Read in iNat metadata
    read_rds(here(
      L2_data_dir,
      "202a_images_clean_EUSA_EPT_obs.rds"
    )),
    join_by(observation_id == id)
  )

table(EUSA_EPT_inat_df$species, EUSA_EPT_inat_df$life_stage)
```


# Get users

```{r}
#| label: get-observers
EUSA_EPT_observers_df <- EUSA_EPT_metadata_df |>
  distinct(user.id)

EUSA_EPT_OBS_df <- EUSA_EPT_metadata_df |>
  select(user.id, id = observation_id) |>
  mutate(id = as.character(id))
```


```{r}
#| label: get-identifiers
ids_df <- EUSA_EPT_metadata_df$identifications
identifiers_data <- tibble()

identifiers_data <- bind_rows(ids_df)

# Get identifiers & ID data
EUSA_EPT_identifiers_df <- identifiers_data |>
  distinct(user.id)
EUSA_EPT_IDS_df <- identifiers_data |>
  select(user.id, id) |>
  mutate(id = as.character(id))

rm(identifiers_data, ids_df)
```

```{r}
#| label: get-annotators
anns_df <- EUSA_EPT_metadata_df$annotations
annotators_data <- tibble()

annotators_data <- bind_rows(anns_df)

# Get annotators & annotation data
EUSA_EPT_annotators_df <- annotators_data |>
  distinct(user.id)
EUSA_EPT_ANN_df <- annotators_data |>
  select(user.id, id = uuid) ## Annotation data only has `uuid`!!!

rm(annotators_data, anns_df)
```

# Join User data

```{r}
#| label: join-dfs
EUSA_EPT_users <- bind_rows(
  EUSA_EPT_annotators_df,
  EUSA_EPT_identifiers_df,
  EUSA_EPT_observers_df
) |>
  distinct()

EUSA_EPT_contrib_info <- bind_rows(
  "annotation" = EUSA_EPT_ANN_df,
  "observation" = EUSA_EPT_OBS_df,
  "identification" = EUSA_EPT_IDS_df,
  .id = "contribution_type"
)
```


```{r}
#| label: Export-data
write_csv(EUSA_EPT_users, here(L3_data_dir, "300a_EUSA_EPT_inat_users.csv"))
write_csv(
  EUSA_EPT_contrib_info,
  here(L3_data_dir, "300b_EUSA_EPT_inat_contributed_info.csv")
)
```
